description: The Wall — a 10,000-tile grid at /wall/. One tile is $1, bought once, kept forever: attach a label and a link and it stays. Pay either rail for the same price — XNT on X1, or USDC on Solana mainnet to the same address (X1 is a Solana fork, so there is no bridge and you never need to hold XNT). Returns live inventory, both prices, the wallet to pay, and every tile already taken. No subscription and no expiry. Outbound links are rel="sponsored nofollow noopener".

count.description: Optional — get an exact quote for this many tiles (1-100).
